Infectious embryofetopathy establishes the infectious_immune axis. Neither the supplied definition nor phenotype evidence establishes fetal respiratory damage; the respiratory-virus parent alone is insufficient.
The injured optic nerve explicitly belongs to the ocular axis. Associated brain injury is not required, so neurological ancestry does not warrant an additional neurologic label.
